dependencyAudit.note: High and critical root advisories require an exact GHSA ID, vulnerable range, installed lock version, reachability argument and an unexpired review window of at most 30 days. New advisories on an accepted package fail. Stale acceptances and reported fixed advisories fail. audit:ci alone contacts the registry; the normal gate is offline.

advisories.reachability: build time only, but genuinely executed: this is the bundler behind `npm run web` and `npm run build:web`, and it reads every image asset in the repo.
advisories.resolution: @expo/metro 56.0.0 pinned metro 0.84.4, which depends on image-size. 56.0.2 pins metro 0.84.5, which dropped image-size altogether. ~56.0.0 is the range expo already declares, so 56.0.2 needed no override — only a lockfile that was not stale. `npm update @expo/metro` moved exactly one version and added nothing else; the full suite and a real `npm run build:web` both pass on 0.84.5.

advisories.reachability: install time only. adm-zip is required by exactly one file, onnxruntime-node/script/install-utils.js, run from that package's postinstall to unpack the ORT native binary out of a .nupkg fetched over TLS from api.nuget.org. The tutor agent's runtime path is onnxruntime-node/dist/binding.js, which only require()s the prebuilt .node addon — grep for adm-zip under dist/ finds nothing. A crafted ZIP therefore needs control of NuGet or a broken TLS chain, not a learner.
advisories.resolution: 2026-10-04: exact scoped onnxruntime-node -> adm-zip 0.6.1 override replaces the vulnerable install-only ZIP parser. Public npm metadata and a clean onnxruntime-node1.24.3 fixture verify the tested release and integrity. The installed constructor, getEntry and extractEntryTo API remain compatible with the native installer; bounded forged-size and symlink extraction checks exercise security fixes. Existing dependency versions and platform binaries are preserved. A clean root manifest npm ci fixture verifies the committed lock; paid voice lifecycle remains a separate acceptance check.

advisories.reachability: was not reached, and is now absent. The advisory is a missing bounds check in uuid v3, v5 and v6 when a caller supplies its own buf; xcode 3.0.1 only called uuid.v4() with no buf (lib/pbxProject.js:90), no source file under apps, packages or services imported uuid, and the chain runs only at build time, when an Expo prebuild writes the Xcode project.
advisories.resolution: 2026-11-16: @expo/config-plugins 57.0.11 and later (still SDK 57) declare xcode ^4.0.0, and xcode 4.0.0 depends only on simple-plist, so uuid left the tree. Every dependant already allowed 57.0.13 (~57.0.10, ~57.0.9, ^57.0.9), so `npm update @expo/config-plugins` changed the lockfile only, with no override; an iOS `expo prebuild --no-install --clean` on xcode 4.0.0 succeeded and wrote a valid project.pbxproj.

advisories.reachability: was reached in the web build only, and is now absent. App.tsx passes the linking config only when Platform.OS is web, so native never parsed links through it; on web, react-navigation decoded address paths and query strings through query-string, so a crafted link opened by a learner could reach the quadratic percent-decoding and freeze that learner's own app. No server, service runtime or other learner was reached, and no source file under apps, packages or services imports query-string or decode-uri-component.
advisories.resolution: 2026-11-18: @react-navigation/core 7.22.1 (2026-09-15) dropped query-string and parses queries with its own lib/module/queryString.js; 7.21.12 and 7.22.0 still declared query-string ^7.1.3. @react-navigation/native 7.3.16 declares core ^7.21.12, so `npm update @react-navigation/core` changed the lockfile only, with no override, and moved 8 entries: core 7.21.12 to 7.25.0, its nested react-is 19.2.8 to 19.3.1, @react-navigation/routers 7.6.4 to 7.6.6, and removed query-string, decode-uri-component, filter-obj, split-on-first and strict-uri-encode. The new serializer keeps query params in insertion order instead of sorting keys.

advisories.chain: @luvani/brain -> zod; @luvani/tutor-agent -> zod, @livekit/agents, openai; @anthropic-ai/sdk -> zod; expo -> @expo/cli -> zod
advisories.reachability: not reached from caller input. Checked 2026-11-02: only packages/brain source imports zod; services/tutor-agent and services/token-server define no zod schemas, and token-server request bodies are not validated with zod. The one constrained collection is ScenarioFrameSchema.beats .min(1) (plus a numeric min/max in typesafe.ts), and those schemas parse LLM structured output from Anthropic or OpenAI, bounded by the request token limit, not learner or caller payloads. Dependencies use of zod (SDK tool schemas, LiveKit, Expo CLI) was not audited line by line.
advisories.why: Fixed only in 4.6.6, a major upgrade. Our ^3.24.1 ranges could move, but @anthropic-ai/sdk, openai, @livekit/agents and @expo/cli all declare zod 3 ranges, so a fix needs a coordinated zod 4 migration. Revisit with the zod 4 migration, and before any zod schema with collection limits validates caller input. Re-reviewed 2026-11-16: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 is unchanged and not withdrawn, 3.25.76 is still the newest zod 3, only eight packages/brain files import zod (as zod/v4), and the only collection limit is still ScenarioFrameSchema.beats .min(1) on model output.

advisories.chain: expo -> @expo/cli -> picomatch 4.0.5; expo -> @expo/metro-config -> picomatch; expo -> @expo/metro -> metro-file-map -> micromatch -> picomatch 2.3.2; @expo/cli -> @expo/metro-file-map -> jest-worker -> jest-util -> picomatch 2.3.2; react-native -> tinyglobby (and fdir) -> picomatch 4.0.5
advisories.reachability: build and dev time only. Checked 2026-11-17: no source file under apps/mobile/src, packages, services or scripts imports picomatch, micromatch, tinyglobby or fdir, and no service lists them as a runtime dependency. The glob patterns they compile come from our own bundler and tooling config, never from learner or caller input, so the ReDoS on single-branch repeated extglobs needs a hostile pattern in our own repo.
advisories.why: No patched release exists: on 2026-11-17 GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf was widened to <=4.0.7, 4.0.7 is the latest picomatch and first_patched_version is null. Two exact versions are installed (4.0.5 at the top level, 2.3.2 under micromatch and jest-util) and cannot be unified, because micromatch 4 declares picomatch ^2, so this record lists both. Founder accepted it for 30 days on 2026-11-17. Revisit when a patched picomatch is published, or at the next Expo or React Native upgrade.
